heavyseas.opening.line1: April 1912. The Northern Star went down.
heavyseas.opening.line2: This boat went over the side with too many aboard, and water for only days.
heavyseas.opening.line3: Nobody is coming that fast. You decide who lasts.
heavyseas.game.helmsman_picks: Navigation: helmsman %s picks one of the %s cards in the rowing stack.
heavyseas.game.top_card: Navigation: nobody rowed, so the top card is turned over.
heavyseas.game.over.landed: Turn %s: the gulls brought a ship. %s made it ashore.
heavyseas.game.over.all_dead: Turn %s: no one is left alive in the boat.
heavyseas.command.no_game: No game running in this world. Start one with /seas start.
heavyseas.command.already_running: A game is already running in this world. End it with /seas end.
heavyseas.command.interrupted: The previous game was not saved (it had reached turn %s). Games are not persisted this milestone.
heavyseas.command.dummy_exists: %s is already reserved for a stand-in.
heavyseas.command.not_action: Not the action phase right now.
heavyseas.command.not_navigation: Not the navigation phase right now.
heavyseas.command.swap_self: You cannot swap seats with yourself.
heavyseas.command.cannot_fight: %s is not conscious, so no fight starts — the unconscious cannot refuse.
heavyseas.command.no_contest: No swap or steal is in progress, or not at that step.
heavyseas.command.cannot_join: %s is not conscious and cannot join this fight.
heavyseas.command.already_fighting: %s is already in the fight and cannot join twice.
heavyseas.command.not_fighting: %s is not in the fight and cannot commit a weapon.
heavyseas.command.contest_pending: %s's move against %s has not finished yet — see it through first.
heavyseas.contest.declared_swap: %s wants to swap seats with %s — agree, or fight?
heavyseas.contest.declared_steal: %s is coming for %s's cards — agree, or fight?
heavyseas.contest.declared_ration: %s plays the shared ration; %s may object.
heavyseas.contest.damage: Everyone on the losing side takes %s.
heavyseas.contest.stolen_hand: %s takes a card at random from %s's hand.
heavyseas.contest.ration_blocked: %s's objection succeeds; the ration has no effect.
heavyseas.contest.consent_wait: Waiting for %s to answer (%s s; no answer means agree).
heavyseas.contest.stances: Taking sides: %s s to join either side, with no backing out.
heavyseas.contest.weapons: Weapons: combatants may commit weapons face down (%s s).
heavyseas.contest.pick_wait: %s is choosing what to take (%s s).
heavyseas.command.not_in_row_stack: That card is not in the rowing stack: %s
heavyseas.hud.you: You are the %s · health %s/%s · %s · thirst marks %s
heavyseas.game.provision_begin: Provision phase: the crate starts at the bow, one card each (%s aboard)
heavyseas.game.provision_empty: The provision deck is empty — drawn out for good, so this phase is skipped.
heavyseas.provision.title: Supply Crate
heavyseas.provision.keep_one: Keep one, pass the rest on (%s in the crate)
heavyseas.hand.title: Your Hand
heavyseas.hand.empty: The crate has not reached you yet.
heavyseas.action.title: Action
heavyseas.action.row_hint: Draw 2 navigation cards, then decide each: onto the rowing stack or back under the deck
heavyseas.action.needs_target: You pick the target in the world, by looking at them - not in this version
heavyseas.action.use_hint: Open your hand, select a provision, then press U to play it
heavyseas.game.top_card_no_helmsman: Navigation: no one is awake to steer, so the top card is turned over.
heavyseas.game.crashed: The game hit an error and was stopped (see the server log).
heavyseas.command.rowing_pending: %s has not finished deciding the rowed cards.
heavyseas.command.no_pick_window: Nobody is picking a navigation card right now.
heavyseas.hud.rowing: Rowing: %s card(s) left to decide · press %s
heavyseas.row.title: Rowing
heavyseas.row.keys: Decide each card · ←→ switch · Esc to put away
heavyseas.helm.title: Helmsman
heavyseas.helm.pick_one: Pick one to play; the rest go back face down (%s in the stack)
heavyseas.game.thirst_choose: Thirst: %s must decide how much water to drink (%s left to answer for).
heavyseas.game.thirst_ask_donors: Thirst: %s cannot play water; others have %s thirst to help with.
heavyseas.game.thirst_no_water: Thirst: %s has no water at all and must take %s.
heavyseas.game.thirst_unconscious: Thirst: %s is unconscious and cannot play water (%s unanswered).
heavyseas.command.not_special: %s is not played as an action.
heavyseas.command.no_thirst_window: Nobody is deciding about water right now.
heavyseas.hud.thirst_donate: Thirst: you can give water to %s - press %s
heavyseas.thirst.title: %s thirst left to answer for
heavyseas.thirst.hint: left/right to choose - enter to confirm
heavyseas.donate.title: Give water to %s
heavyseas.donate.detail: %s still needed - %s donated - you can give %s
heavyseas.donate.hint: Enter to give - Esc to decline - action key to reopen
heavyseas.command.nobody_wounded: Nobody is wounded; the medical kit has no use.
heavyseas.target.title: Whom will you treat with %s?
heavyseas.target.detail: You may treat yourself; the dead cannot be revived
heavyseas.target.hint: Arrow keys to choose - Enter to confirm - Esc to cancel
heavyseas.target.no_longer_valid: That target can no longer be treated; play the medical kit again.
heavyseas.hand.keys: Enter to reveal - U to play (costs your action)
heavyseas.game.thirst_shared: %s shares %s water drunk by others and needs none.
heavyseas.game.thirst_covered: %s is under the parasol; %s thirst cancelled.
heavyseas.game.compass: Compass: helmsman %s draws %s extra into the row stack before choosing.
heavyseas.game.removed: %s is taken by the sea, cards and all.
heavyseas.endgame.begin: Endgame: first whom everyone hates, then whom they love. The last card of each round stays face down.
heavyseas.endgame.withheld_hate: The last card stays down: whom does %s hate?
heavyseas.endgame.withheld_love: The last card stays down: whom does %s love?
heavyseas.reveal.title: Endgame
heavyseas.reveal.round_hate: Endgame · round one: hate (love comes second)
heavyseas.score.title: Scores
heavyseas.hand.affinity: You love: %s · you hate: %s (only you can see this)
heavyseas.hud.contest_you: This one is on you · press %s
heavyseas.consent.title: Your answer
heavyseas.consent.ration: %s has played the shared ration. Do you object?
heavyseas.consent.agree_hint: Let it happen; nobody gets hurt
heavyseas.consent.fight_hint: Fight it out: each side's size plus the weapons they commit; the losers take damage
heavyseas.stance.title: Taking sides
heavyseas.stance.header_swap: %s wants %s's seat — it came to blows
heavyseas.stance.header_steal: %s is coming for %s's cards — it came to blows
heavyseas.stance.header_ration: %s wants to share the ration; %s objects — it came to blows
heavyseas.stance.hint: Once in, you cannot back out or switch · these totals leave out committed weapons
heavyseas.weapon.title: Weapons
heavyseas.weapon.header: Commit a weapon — face down until the fight is settled
heavyseas.weapon.hint: left/right to choose · enter to commit · several are allowed · esc to commit none
heavyseas.pick.title: Take one
heavyseas.pick.from_hand: one at random from the hand (%s cards)
heavyseas.pick.hint: left/right to choose · enter to take · no answer draws one from the hand
heavyseas.command.pile_empty_of: No %s left in the provision deck (%s cards remain).
heavyseas.action.swap_hint: Then go back into the world and right-click them — everyone sees you rise
heavyseas.action.steal_hint: Then go back into the world and right-click them — everyone sees you rise
heavyseas.designate.announce_swap: %s rises, after someone's seat — %s s left.
heavyseas.designate.announce_steal: %s rises, after someone's cards — %s s left.
heavyseas.designate.not_aboard: They are not aboard this boat.
heavyseas.hud.designating: Choosing a target · %s s · right-click them · press %s to sit back down
heavyseas.lobby.overworld_only: The lobby boat can only operate in the Overworld.
heavyseas.lobby.need_players: %s registered; with 6–8 aboard, right-click again to ring the bell and start.
heavyseas.lobby.registered: Registered by sitting down (%s/8); dismount to cancel.
heavyseas.mist_sea.recovered: Your previous Mist Sea voyage ended unexpectedly. Your inventory and return position were restored.
heavyseas.endgame.arrived: The fourth gull parts the fog; the occupied boat glides toward shore.
heavyseas.endgame.spectating: Spectating the finale · private cards and score details remain hidden
